title: hoopsh TeamPack
description: GENERATED by tools/gen-schema.mjs from @hoopsh/data schema.ts — do not edit; regenerate with 'npm run schema:gen'. Hand-editable team/roster pack for the hoopsh engine (formatVersion 2). This schema mirrors validateTeamPack() and adds editor lint (unknown keys rejected). Two rules JSON Schema cannot express are still enforced at load time by 'npm run roster:validate': player ids must be unique, and starters/rotationMinutes must reference ids that exist on the roster.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint — point at data/schema/team-pack.schema.json (relative to this file) for autocomplete and inline validation. Ignored by the loader.

formatVersion.description: Pack format version — must be exactly 2 (checked with !==, not >=; see DATA_PACK_VERSION in packages/data/src/schema.ts for the bump policy).

kind.description: Pack discriminator — team packs are the only kind today.

rating.description: Every rating in the engine — attribute, tendency, or tactic — lives on the same 0-100 scale. 50 is league average; attributes at 50 contribute exactly nothing to any probability model.

attributes.description: What a player CAN do — all 24 keys required, each 0-100. See packages/engine/src/model/player.ts for the authoritative meaning of each dial.

speed.description: max sprint speed (model/derived.ts sprintSpeed); also feeds fatigue's speedShare drain term

accel.description: acceleration off a stop/cut (model/derived.ts acceleration); governs how fast velocity can change each tick in movement.ts

strength.description: physical punch — ai/actions.ts only: the screen-contact "fight" stun term, the screener-selection score, and post-up credibility (posterScore). NOT a rebound input: the rebound lottery reads offReb/defReb/boxout/vertical/heightIn (resolve.ts reboundLottery)

vertical.description: jump — tip-off win chance (possession.ts tipWeightedWinner) and rebound skill weight in resolveRebound (both blend sides). NOT the shot height-advantage term — that is standing reach, height + wingspan only (model/derived.ts reachFt)

lateral.description: lateral defensive slide speed (model/derived.ts lateralSpeed); caps how well a defender mirrors a drive in ai.ts moveSpeed, and dilutes drive handling in decideBall's handlingBase term

stamina.description: how slowly energy drains under load (movement.ts applyFatigue staminaMult); high stamina = longer effective stints before subs.ts pulls a player

finishing.description: layups, dunks, rim pressure — resolve.ts zoneSkill for 'rim' and (partially) 'paint'

midRange.description: touch/footwork on floaters, push shots, mid-post — resolve.ts zoneSkill for 'mid' and (partially) 'paint'

three.description: jump-shooting range skill — resolve.ts zoneSkill for 'three'; also half of ai.ts gravity() (defenses respect this from distance)

freeThrow.description: free-throw shooting touch — resolve.ts freeThrowP base-percentage swing

drawFoul.description: foul-drawing craftiness — resolve.ts shootingFoulP multiplier on the shooter's side (contact-seeking finishers get to the line more)

ballHandle.description: ball-security under pressure — resolve.ts passing.ts stripP (denominator vs a defender's steal), decideBall's drive-handling term, and half of ai.ts creation() (the usage-hierarchy score)

passAcc.description: pass accuracy — resolve.ts passRisk skillTerm (turnover risk) alongside passVision

passVision.description: court vision — resolve.ts passRisk skillTerm; ai.ts swingBonus; half of ai.ts creation() (usage hierarchy); scales the drive kick premium (drive-and-kick is a passing skill)

perimeterD.description: point-of-attack craft — ai.ts on-ball containment vs drives (ai.containDBlend) and resolve.ts contest skill outside the rim area (move.contestDBlend)

interiorD.description: rim-area positioning/verticality — resolve.ts contest skill within 14 ft of the attacked rim (move.contestDBlend); distinct from `block`, which converts misses into blocks

steal.description: on-ball strip and passing-lane instincts — resolve.ts passing stripP and passRisk's lane occlusion (danger-defender weighting)

block.description: shot-blocking timing/length — resolve.ts blockP skill term (chance a rim/paint miss is credited as a block)

contestSkill.description: closeout/contest technique independent of raw speed — resolve.ts contestAt/anticipatedContest skill multiplier, blended with perimeterD/interiorD per move.contestDBlend

offReb.description: offensive-rebound pursuit skill — resolve.ts resolveRebound weight when the crasher's side matches the shooting team

defReb.description: defensive-rebound pursuit skill — resolve.ts resolveRebound weight on the non-shooting side

boxout.description: boxing-out technique — resolve.ts resolveRebound defensive weight only (offense doesn't box out; it crashes)

decisions.description: shot selection & pass reads — ai.ts contestBrakeIQ (extra brake on shooting into a contest as this rises)

consistency.description: STAGED — consumed by the hot/cold variance model (Stage 3); see docs/INTERNALS.md

tendencies.description: What a player WANTS to do — all 14 keys required, each 0-100. Shot-diet keys (shotRim/shotMid/shotThree) are relative appetites, not percentages.

shotRim.description: appetite for rim/paint shots — ai.ts decideBall zoneTend bias when the projected shot is at the rim or in the paint

shotMid.description: appetite for mid-range shots — ai.ts decideBall zoneTend bias when the projected shot is a mid-range look

shotThree.description: appetite for three-point shots — ai.ts decideBall zoneTend bias when the projected shot is a three, stacked with the team's threeBias tactic

pullUp.description: pull-up vs catch-and-shoot inclination — ai.ts decideBall adds a pull-up-specific bias on top of the zone bias when the shot move is 'pull_up'

drive.description: appetite for putting the ball on the floor and attacking — ai.ts decideBall uDrive tendency term (drive utility), scaled by the decide.driveAppetite SimParams knob (a params dial, not a team tactic)

passOut.description: appetite for giving the ball up rather than creating — ai.ts decideBall swingBonus (intrinsic ball-movement value on top of the receiving teammate's shot EV)

iso.description: appetite for clearing out one-on-one — ai.ts actionTick iso-call weight; a live iso boosts the handler's attack (ai.isoDriveBonus)

post.description: appetite for backing a man down — ai.ts actionTick post-call score (with strength/finishing); a posted big draws the entry, works the block, and sprays out of the double

offBallMotion.description: relocations & cuts vs static spot-up — ai.ts offenseOffBallTick per-tick cut-trigger chance

crashOffReb.description: willingness to crash the offensive glass instead of getting back on defense — ai.ts onShotReleased crash-vs-getback roll when a teammate's shot goes up

gambleSteal.description: appetite for gambling into passing lanes for a steal — passing.ts attemptReachIn reach-in attempt rate (more gambling = more steals AND more fouls)

foulAggr.description: physical/aggressive defensive style — resolve.ts shootingFoulP aggr multiplier (tenser closeouts and more contact foul more often)

pushPace.description: STAGED — consumed by the team-pace layer (Stage 2); see docs/INTERNALS.md

usage.description: share of team offense this player is wired to consume — maps directly to real USG%: 50 ≈ 20% (league average), 90 ≈ 30% (superstar load), 10 ≈ 10% (screener/finisher). Applied as CLOSED-LOOP pressure in ai.ts decideBall: the gap between this target and the realized in-game share biases shoot/drive vs pass — an under-fed star hunts, an over-fed one defers. Orthogonal to creation by design (a deferential genius and a low-skill chucker are both expressible).

tactics.description: Team-level style dials — required by the engine (the AI reads threeBias/helpAggr unconditionally; a missing tactics object would crash mid-game).

pace.description: 0-100: walk-it-up .. run-and-gun. Not yet read by decideBall — reserved for the team-pace layer alongside tend.pushPace (see docs/INTERNALS.md Stage 2)

threeBias.description: 0-100: global three-point appetite modifier — ai.ts decideBall tacticsThreeScale term, stacked on top of the shooter's own shotThree tendency

helpAggr.description: 0-100: how aggressively help defense converges — ai.ts defenseTick helper-selection score and off-ball sag depth

id.description: Unique within the roster — starters and rotationMinutes reference this.

name.description: Display name for box scores and play-by-play.

pos.description: Nominal position. The engine assigns matchups by body/skill, so this is descriptive, not prescriptive.

heightIn.description: Height in inches, 60-96 (5'0"-8'0"). Feeds shooting-over-defender geometry, rebounding, and matchup assignment.

weightLb.description: Weight in pounds. Read by defensive matchup-sorting every game — required (the sim refuses to start without it).

wingspanIn.description: Optional wingspan in inches; when absent the engine assumes heightIn + 2 (an average ape index). Feeds standing-reach contest geometry.

id.description: Stable team identifier (used in filenames and CLI flags).

players.description: Roster — at least 8 players (the smallest roster the rotation model can run). Ids must be unique (enforced at load time).

starters.description: Exactly 5 distinct player ids — the opening lineup. Each must exist in players[] (enforced at load time).

rotationMinutes.description: Optional coach minutes targets, { playerId: minutes }. Players without a target sub on fatigue alone. NBA regulation max is 48 — higher is legal but implausible (roster:validate warns).
